title: Calibrated
requirements: Gates of Units 0 to 3; 40 resolved real predictions
evidence: Economy sim at one prediction a day: 40 resolved by day 61

title: Analyst
requirements: Gates of Units 4 to 6; 150 resolved real predictions with total edge above zero, 20 of them month-horizon
evidence: Economy sim at one prediction a day: 151 resolved by day 184

title: Judge
requirements: Gates of Units 7 to 9; 300 resolved real predictions with average confidence within 5 points of hit rate; memory drift within 5 points
evidence: Sim D: over 300 calls a calibrated player passes 97%, a typical overconfident one 2.5%

title: Contender
requirements: Gates of Units 10 to 12, which includes 50 resolved public questions with a better-than-crowd score
evidence: External: Good Judgment Open Relative Brier Score or Metaculus Peer score

title: Elite
requirements: Top 10%, then top 2%, on a public leaderboard across 100 or more questions and 12 months
evidence: The Good Judgment Project named its top 2% superforecasters; about 70% kept the rank the next year
